response.overview: WITT V. AIR FORCE chronicles the story of Major Margaret Witt. Outed as a lesbian, she went from being the poster child of the U.S. Air Force to being deemed “not fit to serve.” Witt candidly recounts her closeted childhood, the pressures of maintaining secrecy about her sexuality, the aftershocks of being ejected from the job she loved and the stirring details of her heroic case, led by attorney Jim Lobsenz, which powered a monumental change in policy and culture.
response.title: Witt V. Air Force
